content.value_statement: Trusted data space projects often fail through weak demand, governance, or participation. This skill provides structured assessment, architecture, rules, rollout, and operating guidance.
actual_capabilities: Assesses feasibility using demand, participant, and operating resource criteria.
Selects among enterprise, industry, city, personal, and cross-border data space models.
Compares sandbox, trusted execution environment, privacy computing, and trusted custodian approaches.
Designs governance rules for admission, authorization, use, benefit allocation, and disputes.
Structures architecture, compliance reviews, pilot scenarios, implementation stages, and operating models.
Produces checklists and outlines for eleven defined project deliverables.
limitations: It does not provide binding legal, regulatory, or certification opinions.
Cost and schedule estimates require local scope, vendors, infrastructure, and participant data.
Technical recommendations require independent security, performance, and compliance validation.
The policy references focus mainly on the Chinese regulatory context.

use_cases.title: Evaluate a Proposed Data Space
use_cases.description: Assess real demand, participant readiness, operating resources, suitable type, and whether construction should proceed.

use_cases.title: Choose a Secure Collaboration Model
use_cases.description: Compare privacy computing, sandboxes, trusted execution environments, and custodial models for a sensitive joint analysis.

use_cases.title: Define Governance and Operations
use_cases.description: Draft participation, authorization, benefit allocation, dispute, pricing, and continuous operating arrangements.

prompt_templates.title: Feasibility Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess whether [organization] should build a trusted data space using demand, participants, resources, risks, and a clear recommendation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner assessment before funding or procurement

prompt_templates.title: Type and Scope Selection
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the five data space types for [scenario], then recommend a scope, lead organization, participants, and first use case.

prompt_templates.title: Architecture and Control Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a four-layer architecture for [scenario], selecting privacy, identity, authorization, audit, sandbox, and trusted execution controls with tradeoffs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Technical design for sensitive multi-party data

prompt_templates.title: Full Delivery Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased roadmap for [initiative] covering governance, agreements, architecture, compliance, pilot delivery, acceptance, operations, metrics, dependencies, and risks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced program planning across multiple organizations

output_examples.input: Should a regional manufacturing association build an industry data space with two interested companies?
output_examples.output: Recommendation: do not begin platform construction yet. Confirm one valuable shared scenario, recruit at least one more committed participant, and secure ongoing operations funding.

output_examples.input: Choose a technical path for joint fraud modeling when both parties treat source data as sensitive.
output_examples.output: Use privacy computing as the primary path. Benchmark performance, restrict outputs, apply strong identity and authorization controls, and preserve auditable consent records.

output_examples.input: Outline governance rules for a city trusted data space.
output: Admission: define eligibility, due diligence, security requirements, and exit conditions.
Authorization: specify purpose, scope, duration, revocation, and onward-use restrictions.
Governance: define voting, audits, incident handling, disputes, and benefit allocation.

best_practices: Validate a real multi-party use case before selecting technology or procuring a platform.
Secure participant commitments and governance agreement before platform construction.
Start with one achievable pilot and measure value, security, performance, and operating effort.
anti_patterns: Do not build a large platform before confirming demand and committed participants.
Do not select privacy technology without workload benchmarks and threat analysis.
Do not leave benefit allocation, accountability, or dispute handling until launch.

faq.question: What is a trusted data space?
faq.answer: It is a governed environment where organizations collaborate on data while preserving control, authorization, auditability, and agreed usage restrictions.

faq.question: Which data space types does the skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers enterprise, industry, city, personal, and cross-border trusted data spaces.

faq.question: Does the skill always recommend building a platform?
faq.answer: No. It recommends proceeding only when demand, committed participants, and sustainable operating resources are credible.

faq.question: Can it select privacy technologies?
faq.answer: It compares privacy computing, sandboxes, trusted execution environments, blockchains, access controls, and trusted custodians at a planning level.

faq.question: Does it replace legal or security review?
faq.answer: No. Qualified specialists must validate regulatory obligations, contracts, security architecture, assessments, and certifications.

faq.question: What information improves the result?
faq.answer: Provide the business scenario, participants, data sensitivity, jurisdiction, expected computations, constraints, budget, timeline, and operating owner.
